entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that processes messages containing optional Information Elements.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity that processes messages containing optional Information Elements.

entities.name: Optional Information Element
entities.description: An optional component of a message that may be included but is not mandatory.

entities.name: Syntactically incorrect optional IE
entities.description: An optional Information Element that does not conform to the expected syntax structure.

entities.name: Treat as not present
entities.description: Behavior where a syntactically incorrect optional IE is ignored as if it were not included in the message.

relations.description: UE establishes the behavior of treating syntactically incorrect optional IEs as not present.
Network establishes the behavior of treating syntactically incorrect optional IEs as not present.
The condition of syntactic incorrectness guards the behavior of treating the IE as not present.
Syntactically incorrect IE is a specific case of an optional IE.
